photos.caption: 27th January 1937---Part of Belgrave's winning team which beat U.S.M. (Paris) pose with Surrey's winning inter-county team at the Television studios, Alexandra Palace. But for our match in Paris coinciding with the inter-county championship, Carter,Penny,Footer and Cohen would have been included in the Surrey team. Belgravians are (l to r) rear row: W.L. Bayliss (President), A.R. Shaw. Centre row: C.T. Carter, A.W. Penny, J.A. Kemp, L.J. Cohen. Front row: A.E. Taylor, H.E. Footer. The central figure is, of course, J.C. Crump and the man on the extreme right, Denis Brickwood--then of Mitcham AC. Six days after these teams were televised by the Baird process, it was announced by the B.B.C. that the E.M.I. process would be adopted!
